local_review.finding_body: The new Neo4j_bolt_connection_nettyTest.java configured database transaction timeouts of 1 and 2 seconds and a server-advertised connection read timeout of 7 seconds (with a matching assertion). These concrete explicit database/read timeouts violate the 10-second minimum in §FS-test-contract.1.7.
local_review.finding_title: Explicit test timeouts below the 10-second floor
local_review.fix_note: Raised both transaction timeouts and the advertised/asserted read timeout to 10 seconds, preserving the exercised protocol behavior while satisfying the required timeout floor. Verified the repaired test on JVM and Native Image along with index, metadata, style, and compilation checks.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the full proposed diff and local evidence for the javac repair. The change is confined to org.neo4j.bolt:neo4j-bolt-connection-netty:4.0.0, uses only reachability-metadata.json, preserves meaningful public-API JVM/native behavior without skips or swallowed failures, and has coherent index and stats records. Dynamic access is 0/0 for both 3.0.0 and 4.0.0, so the ordered repair coverage gate passes at the no-call step. After the timeout correction, validateIndexFiles, checkMetadataFiles, checkstyle, compileTestJava, javaTest, and the full native test lane all pass for the target coordinate. The resulting tree is approved.
